definitions.gloss: school nurse; licensed school health teacher
definitions.explanation: A licensed teacher who staffs a Japanese school's {保健室|ほけんしつ} (health room), handling first aid, illness during school hours, health education, and student wellbeing concerns. Casually referred to as the {保健|ほけん}の{先生|せんせい}.

examples.japanese: {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}に{相談|そうだん}した。
{熱|ねつ}があったので、{養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}が{保護者|ほごしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}した。
examples.english: Since I had a fever, the school nurse contacted my guardian.

examples.japanese: {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}は{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}だけでなく、{心|こころ}のケアも{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: School nurses are in charge of mental health care as well as first aid.

notes:
{養護|ようご} (care, protection) + {教諭|きょうゆ} (licensed teacher). A formal/administrative title used in laws and official documents. In everyday school life, students and parents almost always say {保健|ほけん}の{先生|せんせい} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}に{相談|そうだん}する: to consult the school nurse
- {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}{免許|めんきょ}: school-nurse teaching license
- スクールナース: school nurse (English loanword, less common)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {保健|ほけん}の{先生|せんせい}: 'health teacher' — the everyday term students use
- {保健室|ほけんしつ}: the health room (their workplace)
- {看護師|かんごし}: nurse — the medical profession in general; not a teaching position
